findings.source_quote: But Dirk had died to himself years before when he gave his life to Christ.

findings.translation_quote: لیکن ڈِرک نے برسوں پہلے، جب اس نے اپنی زندگی مسیح کے سپرد کی، اپنے نفس کے لیے مرنا سیکھ لیا تھا۔

findings.source_quote: So that when all is said and done we, too, might run confidently into the welcoming arms of our blessed Savior
